purpose: Cross-treatment synthesis and T3 anomaly/effect audit

exact_10pp_check.reason: With n=60, each one-problem difference equals 1.6666667 percentage points; a six-problem difference therefore equals exactly 10.00 percentage points.

paper_safe_interpretation: Under Treatment 3, exact problem accuracy increased from 32/60 (53.33%) under C0 to 38/60 (63.33%) under C1, an observed increase of 10.00 percentage points. The paired comparison contained 14 C1-only improvements and 8 C0-only regressions, for a net paired effect of 6 problems. The exact two-sided McNemar test gave p = 0.28627872; therefore the observed improvement does not meet the conventional alpha = 0.05 threshold.
